mapper.select: /* JrnlDiaryMapper.getDeletedById */ SELECT diary.id, diary.created_by, diary.jrnl_chapter_id, diary.idx, day.id AS jrnlDayId, day.yy AS yy, day.mnth AS mnth FROM jrnl_diary diary LEFT JOIN jrnl_chapter chapter ON diary.jrnl_day_id = chapter.id LEFT JOIN jrnl_day day ON chapter.jrnl_day_id = day.id WHERE diary.id = #{id}
